svg.title: Compare Contribution Yield Before Buying
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-specialty-contribution-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Contribution Yield Before Buying; subtitle: Five illustrative specialty and settlement combinations, measured on equal $10,000 sales.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Each numeric value is a percentage of a hypothetical $10,000 sale remaining after equipment acquisition, refurbishment, freight, transaction costs, and modeled warranty expense, before shared overhead. These are screening examples, not observed market yields or scenario net margins. Payment method alone does not determine yield.; caption: Use quoted unit costs to replace these assumptions. The Base-Case waterfall has 30% contribution before 14% overhead; these specialty bars are not a weighted revenue mix or a replacement scorecard.; stages: label: Diagnostic ultrasound with bank settlement; value: 32% contribution | $3,200 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 32.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,400 acquisition, $900 refurbishment, and $500 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $3,200. Test probes for defects and verify software-license transfer before accepting the apparent spread.; label: Surgical instrument sets with bank settlement; value: 35% contribution | $3,500 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $4,700 acquisition, $1,300 refurbishment, and $500 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $3,500. Confirm set completeness and reusable-device instructions; exclude single-use reprocessing from this illustration.; label: Veterinary monitors with bank settlement; value: 28% contribution | $2,800 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 28.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,600 acquisition, $1,000 refurbishment, and $600 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $2,800. Verify intended animal use, compatible accessories, and service access rather than assuming human-device equivalence.; label: Aesthetic laser with card settlement; value: 24% contribution | $2,400 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,500 acquisition, $1,300 refurbishment, and $800 delivery, card, and warranty costs leaves $2,400. Validate handpiece life, energy output, destination requirements, and dispute exposure before releasing equipment.; label: Diagnostic cart with third-party lender settlement; value: 30% contribution | $3,000 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,300 acquisition, $1,100 refurbishment, and $600 delivery, settlement, and warranty costs leaves $3,000. Confirm lender acceptance conditions, payout timing, and recourse terms; funding approval alone is not settled proceeds.

circle.title: label: Diagnostic ultrasound with bank settlement; value: 32% contribution | $3,200 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 32.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,400 acquisition, $900 refurbishment, and $500 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $3,200. Test probes for defects and verify software-license transfer before accepting the apparent spread.

text.title: Surgical instrument sets with bank settlement

circle.title: label: Surgical instrument sets with bank settlement; value: 35% contribution | $3,500 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $4,700 acquisition, $1,300 refurbishment, and $500 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $3,500. Confirm set completeness and reusable-device instructions; exclude single-use reprocessing from this illustration.

label: Veterinary monitors with bank settlement; value: 28% contribution | $2,800 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 28.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,600 acquisition, $1,000 refurbishment, and $600 delivery, payment, and warranty costs leaves $2,800. Verify intended animal use, compatible accessories, and service access rather than assuming human-device equivalence.

label: Aesthetic laser with card settlement; value: 24% contribution | $2,400 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,500 acquisition, $1,300 refurbishment, and $800 delivery, card, and warranty costs leaves $2,400. Validate handpiece life, energy output, destination requirements, and dispute exposure before releasing equipment.

circle.title: label: Diagnostic cart with third-party lender settlement; value: 30% contribution | $3,000 per $10,000 sale; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $10,000 sale less $5,300 acquisition, $1,100 refurbishment, and $600 delivery, settlement, and warranty costs leaves $3,000. Confirm lender acceptance conditions, payout timing, and recourse terms; funding approval alone is not settled proceeds.
